validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <parallel id="p">
    <state id="only">
      <transition event="go" target="f"/>
    </state>
  </parallel>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: a parallel state with one child runs nothing in parallel

notes: as a <state>, the region becomes the default child; completion differs: a <parallel> completes when all regions reach final states, while a <state> completes only when one of its own <final> children is entered
diagnostics.help: use `<state>` instead, or add the missing orthogonal regions
